title: Black Blackbeard
summary: A control deck that switches off your opponent's [On Play] effects. Your Leader's own [On Play]s are negated too, so the deck uses Characters with Activate and On K.O. effects instead. Few players use it, but it wins often.
gamePlan: Your Leader: trash 1 card to negate your opponent's [On Play] effects until the end of their next turn. Use it before their big turn.
Remember your own [On Play] effects don't work. Your cards use [Activate: Main] and [On K.O.] instead.
Early turns: Laffitte digs for Blackbeard Pirates, Stronger and Doc Q lower costs and K.O. small Characters.
Van Augur gives -3 cost, then Doc Q or Marshall.D.Teach (ST27-005) K.O.s the now-cheap Character.
Jesus Burgess gets stronger as your trash fills up, and it can't be K.O.'d by effects. Kuzan (OP10-082) can't be removed at all.

keyCards.why: Leader. Trash a card to negate your opponent's [On Play] effects.
Laffitte. Digs 5 deep for a Blackbeard Pirates card.
Van Augur. -3 cost to set up K.O.s.
Jesus Burgess. Can't be K.O.'d by effects; grows with your trash.
Kuzan. Can't be removed by your opponent's effects.
Marshall.D.Teach. 12000 [Blocker] that can negate the opposing Leader.

howItWins: You shut off the effects your opponent's deck relies on, pick off their Characters, and win with Characters they can't remove.
weakTo: Decks that win with [Activate] or [When Attacking] effects instead of [On Play].
It's hard to play well: you have to time the Leader's negate and count costs.
mulliganTips: Keep Laffitte and cheap Characters. Don't keep a hand that needs [On Play] effects.
